# scenario nick_change: what the core told the UI, and where it ended up.
# Recorded from internal/irc + internal/state. Regenerate with
# `go test ./internal/transcript -update`, and read doc.go before you do.

stream registration
	conn "connecting"
	conn "ready"
	conn "registering"
	rail
	self <eco>
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"

stream 0 C: join #eco

stream 2 S: :eco!eco@test JOIN #eco / :irc.test 332 eco #eco :topic / :irc.test 353 eco = #eco :@alice eco +bob / :irc.test 366 eco #eco :End of /NAMES list.
	members #eco "alice(@),bob(+),eco"
	rail
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	topic #eco "topic"

stream 5 S: :bob!bob@test NICK bobby
	members #eco "alice(@),bobby(+),eco"
	status #eco "bob is now known as bobby"

stream 6 S: @msgid=t1 :alice!alice@test TOPIC #eco :a new topic
	status #eco "alice set the topic: a new topic"
	topic #eco "a new topic"

stream 7 S: :eco!eco@test NICK eco2
	members #eco "alice(@),bobby(+),eco2"
	self <eco2>
	status #eco "eco is now known as eco2"

stream 8 S: @msgid=t2 :alice!alice@test PRIVMSG #eco :ping eco2, are you there
	msg #eco <alice> [highlight] "ping eco2, are you there"
	unread #eco

stream 9 S: @msgid=t3 :alice!alice@test PRIVMSG #eco :and eco is nobody now
	msg #eco <alice> "and eco is nobody now"
	unread #eco

state #eco topic="a new topic" modes="" key="" members=[alice(@) bobby(+) eco2]
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	status #eco "bob is now known as bobby"
	status #eco "alice set the topic: a new topic"
	status #eco "eco is now known as eco2"
	msg #eco <alice> [highlight] "ping eco2, are you there"
	msg #eco <alice> "and eco is nobody now"

state server topic="" modes="" key="" members=[]
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
